title: cosmos montanus var. typicus
intro: Cosmos montanus var. typicus, commonly known as Mexican cosmos, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mexican cosmos include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve wound healing, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
